integrity: Complete combinatorial proof supplied. Seven exhaustive small profiles and an independent algebraic coefficient implementation corroborate the result; finite tests are not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Proof assumes at least two complete-multipartite parts of size at least two. Generic bases, singleton parts and arbitrary-corona recurrence not covered; residual unindexed-literature overlap risk.
title: Power-domination polynomial of whiskered complete multipartite graphs
